author: Inside Edition
description: Golf superstar Tiger Woods could be facing an uphill battle to stay out of jail following his latest arrest. Woods was arrested after flipping his car while allegedly under the influence. He overturned his SUV Friday near his $50 million home in Jupiter Island, Florida. He willingly took a breathalyzer test and passed, but then he refused to give a urine sample.
title: Will Tiger Woods Go To Jail After Latest Arrest?

author: Inside Edition
description: Video captured a BMW racing toward cyclists who were riding in the bike lane. Someone in the BMW threw a water bottle at one of the cyclists and flipped him off. That cyclist is Luke Fetzer and he tells Inside Edition after the BMW first swerved at him, he sprayed his water bottle at the car, but says that did not warrant the BMW driver's dangerous maneuvers. Five days after the incident, police arrested Samir Weiss, the driver of the BMW, on charges of assault with a deadly weapon.
title: BMW Caught On Camera Racing Toward Cyclists In Bike Lane

author: Inside Edition
description: Arnold Schwarzenegger's son Joseph Baena took home top honors at his first bodybuilding competition, winning three gold medals and a silver. The 28-year-old's poses were identical to his dad's from Schwarzenegger's Mr. Olympia heyday. Baena chronicled competition day. Baena celebrated his big win by strolling around shirtless in Santa Monica. Speaking of lifting lots of weight, 9-year-old Lucy Milgrim has set three weightlifting records. Milgrim and her parents spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Arnold Schwarzenegger's Son Wins 1st Bodybuilding Competition

author: Inside Edition
description: Former middle school teacher Ashley Fisler, who was twice nominated as teacher of the year, has been charged with sexually assaulting a middle school student. The student, who is now an adult, told police he and the teacher had "multiple sexual encounters in Fisler's vehicle and in her classroom" in New Jersey in 2021. Fisler is also accused of sending the boy "multiple nude photographs" of herself. Inside Edition spoke to the teacher's attorney, Rocco Cipparone, who says Fisler denies the allegations.
title: Former Middle School Teacher Charged With Sexual Assault

author: Inside Edition
description: Members of Riverside County Fire and a deputy used an unconventional way to rescue four cats that were stuck inside a senior living complex in Southern California that caught fire in March. The firefighters used oxygen masks and CPR to save the felines after they were trapped inside one of the apartments and needed to be rescued. Dozens of people were displaced by the blaze.
title: Firefighters and Deputy Use CPR, Oxygen To Rescue Cats From Burning Apartment

author: Inside Edition
description: It's a 47-year- old mystery: What happened to Ronald Westwick? Police in Iowa say he vanished without a trace. The case has long gone cold, but investigators say they have hope of finally getting some answers. KCCI reports Westwick, who was 34 at the time, left from Ellsworth on March 12, 1979 to go out in Ames. Jerry Greenfield is Westwick's cousin and reportedly his last living relative. She says she would like to see him brought home. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Police Still Trying To Find Ronald Westwick Who Went Missing In 1979
